parameters.label: Active
parameters.name: active
parameters.description: While on, the  DAT  will respond to the Parameter that is referenced.

parameters.label: OPs
parameters.name: op
parameters.description: Specify which operator(s) the triggering parameter belongs to.

parameters.label: Parameters
parameters.name: pars
parameters.description: Specify which parameter(s) to monitor for triggering the script.

parameters.label: Callback  Mode
parameters.name: callbackmode
parameters.description: ⊞  - This controls the format of the 'curr' and 'prev' arguments to the callbacks.

parameters.label: Per  ParGroup  Change
parameters.name: pargroup
parameters.description: 'curr' and 'prev' are individual  ParGroup  objects.

parameters.label: Combine  ParGroup  Changes as List
parameters.name: pargrouplist
parameters.description: 'curr' and 'prev' are lists of all changed parameters.

parameters.label: Value Change
parameters.name: valuechange
parameters.description: The onValueChange() method executes when the parameter value specified changes value in any way. It is called once each frame.

parameters.label: On  Pulse
parameters.name: onpulse
parameters.description: The onPulse() method executes when a 'pulse' type parameter is pulsed by clicking on it or via the  Par .pulse() method.

parameters.label: Expression  Change
parameters.name: expressionchange
parameters.description: The onExpressionChange() method executes whenever the specified parameter's expression changes. For example, changing the expression from  me.time.frame  to  me.time.seconds  will trigger the script.

parameters.label: Export  Change
parameters.name: exportchange
parameters.description: The onExportChange() method executes if the export path to the specified parameter changes. For example, if the parameter is being exported to from /chopname/chan1 and that is changed so /chopname2/chan2 is now exporting to it, then the script will be triggered.

parameters.label: Enable Change
parameters.name: enablechange
parameters.description: The onEnableChange() method executes if the specified parameter goes from being disabled to enabled.

parameters.label: Mode Change
parameters.name: modechange
parameters.description: The onModeChange() method executes if the specified  parameter's mode  changes between the available constant, expression, export or bind mode.

parameters.label: Custom
parameters.name: custom
parameters.description: Monitor  Custom Parameters .

parameters.label: Built-In
parameters.name: builtin
parameters.description: Monitor Built-In parameters.

parameters.label: Edit..
parameters.name: edit
parameters.description: Clicking this opens a text editor to edit text in the  DAT .

parameters.label: File
parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The filesystem path and name of the file to load. Accepts  .txt  and  .dat  files.

parameters.label: Sync to File
parameters.name: syncfile
parameters.description: When On, loads the file from disk into the  DAT  when the projects starts.  A filename must be specified.  Turning on the option will load the file from disk immediately.  If the file does not exist, it will be created the first time the  DAT  is updated.  The file is monitored so that any changes made to the file will update the  DAT , and any changes made to the  DAT  will be written to the file right away.  If the file is removed, the  DAT  will retain its current contents.

parameters.label: Load on Start
parameters.name: loadonstart
parameters.description: When On, reloads the file from disk into the  DAT  when the projects starts.

parameters.label: Load File
parameters.name: loadonstartpulse
parameters.description: Instantly reloads the file.

parameters.label: Write on Toe Save
parameters.name: write
parameters.description: When On, writes the contents of the  DAT  out to the file on disk when the project is saved.

parameters.label: Write File
parameters.name: writepulse
parameters.description: Instantly write the file to disk.

parameters.label: An  Operator Family  that manipulates text strings: multi
parameters.description: line text or tables. Multi-line text is often a python  Script  or  GLSL  Shader, but can be any multi-line text.  Tables  are rows and columns of cells, each containing a text string.

parameters.label: To "pulse" a parameter is to send it a signal from (1) an  exported  CHOP channel or (2) a python command or (3) a mouse click that causes a new action to occur immediately. A pulse via python is via the  .pulse()  function on a pulse
parameters.description: type parameter, such as Reset parameter in a  Speed CHOP . A pulse from a CHOP is typically a 0 to 1 to 0 signal in an exported channel.
